goal: Prevent wallet history RPCs from fabricating recipient sends and negative fees for mixed-input transactions
Report accurate aggregate debits and credits for CoinJoins and Payjoins, including after rescans
reviewability: Open feedback on entry formatting and caching does not block review
agreement: Support for omitting speculative data the wallet cannot know (murchandamus, arejula27)
Past objections to dropping send entries were addressed by keeping aggregate debits (luke-jr, rkrux)
Objection to omitting send entries was addressed in code but not explicitly withdrawn (achow101)
Open suggestions on entry layout and avoiding duplicate accounting calls (arejula27, Bicaru20)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it fixes bogus recipient entries and negative fees for mixed-input transactions
Restores correct history accounting for CoinJoin and Payjoin users after rescans or descriptor imports
